summary.description: A concise summary of the entire supplied scene written in target_lang. Account for alternative branches without treating mutually exclusive events as one continuous path.

translations.description: Contains exactly one translated entry for every input text object in a normal request. When retry_seqs is present, contains exactly one entry for each listed seq and no others.

seq.description: The seq copied unchanged from the corresponding input text object.

text.description: The translated target-language text. Every protected placeholder label must be preserved exactly.
